1	# Cerne — Prototype extract
2	
3	The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.
4	
5	- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
6	- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
7	- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## 1. Navigation map
12	
13	The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).
14	
15	```
16	Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
17	  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
18	  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
19	  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
20	  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
21	  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat
22	
23	Home/Chat (base screen)
24	  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
25	  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
26	  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
27	        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)
28	
29	Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
30	  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
31	  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
32	  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period
33	
34	Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)
35	
36	Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
37	  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
38	  ├─ inline profile-name editing
39	  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
40	  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
41	  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
42	```
43	
44	---
45	
46	## 2. Navigable states
47	
48	Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.
49	
50	### 2.1 Entry and authentication
51	| State | What it shows |
52	|---|---|
53	| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
54	| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
55	| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |
56	| Tela 0.1a — Criar conta | Same screen in sign-up mode: title "Crie sua conta", CTA "Criar conta" (toggled by a text link, not a separate screen). |
57	| Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial | Title "Digite seu PIN", 4 progress dots, 3×4 numeric keypad with backspace; after the 4th digit, moves on after 350 ms. |
58	| Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha | Same as 0.1b plus the error band "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN". |
59	
60	### 2.2 Conversation
61	| State | What it shows |
62	|---|---|
63	| Tela 1 — Home/Chat (default) | Messages going back and forth; dark green fixed header with ☰ and wordmark; composer with "+", placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...", send icon. |
64	| Tela 1 — Streaming | AI response revealed progressively with a pulsing cursor. |
65	| Tela 1 — Insight | Insight card with ochre spine, label "INSIGHT", "x" to dismiss, interleaved in the messages. |
66	| Tela 1 — Falha ao gerar resposta | Incomplete AI message with "Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente" in red, in place of the time. |
67	| Tela 1 — Bookmark | Bookmark on each user message with 4 sub-states: `idle`, `saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning). |
68	| Tela 1 — Offline | Blue-gray banner "Sem conexão — histórico disponível, novas mensagens bloqueadas"; send icon disabled. |
69	| Tela 1 — Sessão expirada | Light scrim over the chat (still readable), centered card with lock icon, title "Sessão expirada", text saying history and scroll position are kept, button "Entrar novamente". |
70	| Tela 3 — Menu lateral | Drawer: initials avatar and name; section "CONVERSAS" with past sessions (title + timestamp); items "Meus Registros", "Planos de Ação", "Configurações"; new-conversation action. |
71	
72	### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
73	Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.
74	
75	| State | What it shows |
76	|---|---|
77	| Texto | Multiline field, placeholder "Escreva livremente...", button "Salvar". |
78	| Áudio — Gravando | Red stop button, animated 12-bar waveform, monospace timer (e.g., "00:12"). |
79	| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |
80	| Áudio — Transcrito | Editable transcribed text; original audio duration in mono; "Salvar" enabled. |
81	| Áudio — Erro | Red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente". |
82	| Foto — Captura | Two large buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria". |
83	| Foto — Processando OCR | Photo thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto...". |
84	| Foto — Reconhecido | Small thumbnail next to the extracted (editable) text; "Salvar". |
85	| Foto — Erro | Thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", button "Tentar novamente" and secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". |
86	
87	### 2.4 Records
88	| State | What it shows |
89	|---|---|
90	| Tela 4 — Meus Registros (default) | Records grouped by date ("Hoje", "Ontem", dates); each card with a spine colored by origin, source icon, time, sync indicator (green "sincronizado" / ochre "sincronizando" / red "erro de sync"), text excerpt, category chips when present; header with back arrow, title, download icon; search bar "Buscar nos registros..." with a funnel button. |
91	| Tela 4 — Vazio | Large notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", CTA "Criar primeiro registro". |
92	| Tela 4 — Filtros ativos | Removable chips under the search bar with the applied filters, link "Limpar filtros"; funnel button filled. |
93	| Tela 4 — Sheet de filtro | Groups "INTERVALO DE DATA" (Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês, single choice), "CATEGORIA" (chips: trabalho, rotina, descanso, relações), "TIPO DE ENTRADA" (chips: manual, áudio, foto, chat); "Aplicar" and "Limpar". **Note:** the backend has no category filter (requirements, RF06); categories are the tags extension. |
94	
95	### 2.5 Export (bottom sheet over Tela 4; 5 states)
96	| State | What it shows |
97	|---|---|
98	| Pendente | Spinner, "Preparando exportação...". |
99	| Processando | "Gerando resumo com IA...", progress bar. |
100	| Concluído | Green check, "Resumo pronto", buttons "Baixar PDF" (primary) and "Baixar dados brutos" (outline). |
101	| Erro | Red warning; text explaining that the AI narrative failed but the data remains available; only the button "Baixar dados brutos". |
102	| Período vazio | "Nenhum registro nesse período." and a suggestion to adjust the filter; no download button. |
103	
104	All five have the link "Fechar" at the bottom. The mapping between these states and the backend job statuses is in `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`.
105	
106	### 2.6 Plans and settings
107	| State | What it shows |
108	|---|---|
109	| Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]** | Three horizontally scrolling columns — "A Fazer", "Em Andamento", "Concluído" — with counts and cards. |
110	| Tela 6 — Configurações — mais de 30 registros | "Sua evolução": 10-bar ochre chart + summary paragraph. |
111	| Tela 6 — Configurações — uma entrada | A single small bar and the text "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias." |
112	| Tela 6 — Configurações — zero entradas | Light-gray chart icon in place of the chart and "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; no summary paragraph. |
113	| Tela 6 — Configurações — narrativa indisponível | Chart with data, but the AI summary paragraph failed — needs its own error message, not just missing text. |
114	| Tela 6 — Confirmar exclusão de conta | Centered dialog, red title "Apagar sua conta?", text on permanent, irreversible deletion; red button "Apagar tudo"; outline "Cancelar". |
115	
116	Other elements of Configurações: avatar with editable name/e-mail (pencil becomes a check in edit mode — inline editing); persona cards "Como a IA responde" (Analítico, Empático, Socrático) **[ext]**; actions "Sair" and "Apagar conta" (red).
117	
118	---
119	
120	## 3. Visual system (tokens for `design_tokens.dart`)
121	
122	The prototype has a **Design Tokens** panel, marked as the ground truth for `design_tokens.dart`. Its names and values are below.

# Cerne — Prototype extract

The visual reference of the product is `cerne-prototype.html` (this folder). Open it in a browser; it needs JavaScript. This extract lists its navigable states, its visual tokens, its components and the implementation notes that come with it.

- **Frame:** 390 × 844 logical points, portrait only, 4 dp grid.
- **Language of the interface:** Portuguese. Every UI text below appears exactly as in the prototype, in quotes.
- **Precedence:** the prototype defines appearance and states. Behavior rules (triggers, timings, filters, error handling) are defined in `docs/input/requirements.md`; where the prototype's simulated behavior differs from a requirement, the requirement prevails.

---

## 1. Navigation map

The prototype has **32 navigable states**, reachable from a single state machine (a `screen` variable plus overlay flags). Not every state is a new full screen — several are **overlays** (modal, sheet, bottom sheet, dialog) shown on top of one of three base screens: **Home/Chat**, **Meus Registros** and **Configurações**. Overlays preserve the screen underneath (it stays visible, with a darkened scrim behind).

```
Splash (auto, 1.8 s)
  └─> Biometria ──tap/error──> PIN inicial / PIN após falha
  │      └─> "usar e-mail e senha" ──> Entrar / criar conta (toggle)
  │                                          └─> submit ──> Home/Chat
  └─(PIN complete, 4 digits)──> Home/Chat
  └─(Face ID/Touch ID ok)──> Home/Chat

Home/Chat (base screen)
  ├─ overlay: Sessão expirada (backend session expires; "Entrar novamente" ──> Biometria)
  ├─ overlay: side menu (☰ icon) ──> Meus Registros | Planos de Ação | Configurações | new conversation
  └─ overlay: Insertion modal ("+" button) ──> tabs Texto / Áudio / Foto, each with its own sub-states
        (on save, the modal closes and returns to Home/Chat with the record added)

Meus Registros (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ empty state (no records) ──CTA "Criar primeiro registro"──> Insertion modal
  ├─ overlay: filter sheet ──"Aplicar"──> active filters (chips on the list)
  └─ overlay: export card (download icon) ──> pending ──> processing ──> done | error | empty period

Planos de Ação (base screen, from the side menu) — static screen, 3-column kanban (extension, not implemented)

Configurações (base screen, from the side menu)
  ├─ dashboard variations: zero entries | one entry | more than 30 (with narrative) | narrative unavailable
  ├─ inline profile-name editing
  ├─ AI persona selection (Analítico / Empático / Socrático) (extension, not implemented)
  ├─ "Sair" ──> Biometria
  └─ overlay: account-deletion confirmation ──"Apagar tudo"──> Biometria (same destination as logout)
```

---

## 2. Navigable states

Names as they appear in the prototype. The prototype's own state catalog has 32 entries: Tela 0 — Splash; Tela 0.1 — Biometria; Tela 0.1a — Entrar / criar conta; Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial; Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha; Tela 1 — Home / Chat; Tela 2 — Texto, Áudio (Gravando, Processando, Transcrito, Erro), Foto (Captura, Processando OCR, Reconhecido, Erro); Tela 3 — Menu lateral; Tela 1 — Sessão expirada; Tela 4 — Meus Registros, Estado vazio, Sheet de filtro, Filtros ativos; Exportar — Pendente, Processando, Concluído, Erro, Período vazio; Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]**; Tela 6 — Configurações, Dashboard zero entradas, Dashboard uma entrada, Narrativa indisponível, Confirmar exclusão. The tables below group them by screen; some rows describe variations inside one state (e.g., the bookmark sub-states, the streaming response). Extension states (requirements, section 2) are marked **[ext]**.

### 2.1 Entry and authentication
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 0 — Splash | Wordmark "Cerne" centered on dark green, 3 loading dots; lasts 1.8 s and moves on automatically. |
| Tela 0.1 — Biometria | Fingerprint circle, title "Toque para desbloquear", link "Usar PIN", secondary link "usar e-mail e senha" near the bottom. |
| Tela 0.1a — Entrar | Login mode: title "Bem-vindo de volta", fields E-mail and Senha, CTA "Entrar", toggle link, link "usar biometria". |
| Tela 0.1a — Criar conta | Same screen in sign-up mode: title "Crie sua conta", CTA "Criar conta" (toggled by a text link, not a separate screen). |
| Tela 0.1b — PIN inicial | Title "Digite seu PIN", 4 progress dots, 3×4 numeric keypad with backspace; after the 4th digit, moves on after 350 ms. |
| Tela 0.1c — PIN após falha | Same as 0.1b plus the error band "Não foi possível reconhecer — digite seu PIN". |

### 2.2 Conversation
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 1 — Home/Chat (default) | Messages going back and forth; dark green fixed header with ☰ and wordmark; composer with "+", placeholder "Escreva uma mensagem...", send icon. |
| Tela 1 — Streaming | AI response revealed progressively with a pulsing cursor. |
| Tela 1 — Insight | Insight card with ochre spine, label "INSIGHT", "x" to dismiss, interleaved in the messages. |
| Tela 1 — Falha ao gerar resposta | Incomplete AI message with "Falha ao gerar resposta — toque para tentar novamente" in red, in place of the time. |
| Tela 1 — Bookmark | Bookmark on each user message with 4 sub-states: `idle`, `saving` (spinner), `saved` (ochre check), `error` (red warning). |
| Tela 1 — Offline | Blue-gray banner "Sem conexão — histórico disponível, novas mensagens bloqueadas"; send icon disabled. |
| Tela 1 — Sessão expirada | Light scrim over the chat (still readable), centered card with lock icon, title "Sessão expirada", text saying history and scroll position are kept, button "Entrar novamente". |
| Tela 3 — Menu lateral | Drawer: initials avatar and name; section "CONVERSAS" with past sessions (title + timestamp); items "Meus Registros", "Planos de Ação", "Configurações"; new-conversation action. |

### 2.3 Insertion modal (bottom sheet over Home/Chat; 9 states)
Common structure: "x" to close and a 3-tab bar (Texto / Áudio / Foto); the active tab has a filled dark-green background.

| State | What it shows |
|---|---|

| Áudio — Processando | Spinner in place of stop; frozen, faded waveform (opacity .35); text "Transcrevendo..."; label "00:42 de áudio". |
| Áudio — Transcrito | Editable transcribed text; original audio duration in mono; "Salvar" enabled. |
| Áudio — Erro | Red warning icon, "Não foi possível transcrever", outline button "Tentar novamente". |
| Foto — Captura | Two large buttons, "Câmera" and "Galeria". |
| Foto — Processando OCR | Photo thumbnail, spinner, "Reconhecendo texto...". |
| Foto — Reconhecido | Small thumbnail next to the extracted (editable) text; "Salvar". |
| Foto — Erro | Thumbnail kept, warning icon, "Não foi possível reconhecer o texto", button "Tentar novamente" and secondary text action "Salvar só a foto". |

### 2.4 Records
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 4 — Meus Registros (default) | Records grouped by date ("Hoje", "Ontem", dates); each card with a spine colored by origin, source icon, time, sync indicator (green "sincronizado" / ochre "sincronizando" / red "erro de sync"), text excerpt, category chips when present; header with back arrow, title, download icon; search bar "Buscar nos registros..." with a funnel button. |
| Tela 4 — Vazio | Large notebook icon, "Nenhum registro ainda", CTA "Criar primeiro registro". |
| Tela 4 — Filtros ativos | Removable chips under the search bar with the applied filters, link "Limpar filtros"; funnel button filled. |
| Tela 4 — Sheet de filtro | Groups "INTERVALO DE DATA" (Todo o período / Esta semana / Este mês, single choice), "CATEGORIA" (chips: trabalho, rotina, descanso, relações), "TIPO DE ENTRADA" (chips: manual, áudio, foto, chat); "Aplicar" and "Limpar". **Note:** the backend has no category filter (requirements, RF06); categories are the tags extension. |

### 2.5 Export (bottom sheet over Tela 4; 5 states)
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Pendente | Spinner, "Preparando exportação...". |
| Processando | "Gerando resumo com IA...", progress bar. |
| Concluído | Green check, "Resumo pronto", buttons "Baixar PDF" (primary) and "Baixar dados brutos" (outline). |
| Erro | Red warning; text explaining that the AI narrative failed but the data remains available; only the button "Baixar dados brutos". |
| Período vazio | "Nenhum registro nesse período." and a suggestion to adjust the filter; no download button. |

All five have the link "Fechar" at the bottom. The mapping between these states and the backend job statuses is in `docs/input/backend/export-screen-states.md`.

### 2.6 Plans and settings
| State | What it shows |
|---|---|
| Tela 5 — Planos de Ação **[ext]** | Three horizontally scrolling columns — "A Fazer", "Em Andamento", "Concluído" — with counts and cards. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — mais de 30 registros | "Sua evolução": 10-bar ochre chart + summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — uma entrada | A single small bar and the text "Ainda é cedo pra ver um padrão — volte em alguns dias." |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — zero entradas | Light-gray chart icon in place of the chart and "Comece a registrar para ver sua evolução aqui"; no summary paragraph. |
| Tela 6 — Configurações — narrativa indisponível | Chart with data, but the AI summary paragraph failed — needs its own error message, not just missing text. |
| Tela 6 — Confirmar exclusão de conta | Centered dialog, red title "Apagar sua conta?", text on permanent, irreversible deletion; red button "Apagar tudo"; outline "Cancelar". |

Other elements of Configurações: avatar with editable name/e-mail (pencil becomes a check in edit mode — inline editing); persona cards "Como a IA responde" (Analítico, Empático, Socrático) **[ext]**; actions "Sair" and "Apagar conta" (red).

        required: true

          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 1
              required:
              - email
              - password
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Success
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  data:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      session:
                        type: object
                        properties:

                            type: string
                          refreshToken:
                            type: string
                          expiresIn:
                            type: integer
                          expiresAt:
                            type: integer
                          tokenType:
                            type: string
                        required:
                        - accessToken

                        - expiresIn
                        - expiresAt
                        - tokenType
                        additionalProperties: {}
                      user:
                        type: object
                        properties:
                          id:
                            type: string
                            format: uuid

                            type: string
                            format: email
                        required:

                            format: email

                    type: object
                    additionalProperties: {}
                required:
                - data

# Implementation Plan: P-F000 — Foundation

**Branch**: `001-foundation` (spec directory only — no git branch exists; see spec header)

**Date**: 2026-10-11 | **Spec**: [spec.md](./spec.md)

**Input**: Feature specification from `/specs/001-foundation/spec.md`, `docs/input/requirements.md` §12
(delivery order) and §13 (technical constraints), and `.specify/memory/constitution.md`.

## Summary

F000 is the foundation every later unit (RF03 → RF09) builds on: the Flutter project scaffold and
Clean Architecture folder convention, `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` as the single visual-value
source, a `dio`-based HTTP client whose repositories return `Either<Failure, T>` (fpdart) mapped
from the backend's closed 13-code error taxonomy, the login/sign-up screen (toggle, not two
screens), splash-time session check with silent refresh, base navigation (Home/Chat shell, side
menu/drawer, Meus Registros and Configurações placeholders), and the "Sessão expirada" overlay that
preserves underlying screen state. It consumes exactly 4 of the backend's 23 Edge Functions
(`auth-signup`, `auth-login`, `auth-refresh`, `auth-session`) and implements no RF01–RF10 behavior.

## Technical Context

**Language/Version**: Dart 3.13.4 / Flutter 3.47.5 (stable channel), pinned to the project via
`fvm` (already present on this machine's global fvm cache — see [research.md](./research.md) R1).

**Primary Dependencies**:
- `flutter_bloc` (state management — fixed by constitution)
- `fpdart` (`Either<Failure, T>` — fixed by constitution)
- `dio` (HTTP client — chosen, see R2)
- `go_router` (navigation — chosen, see R3)
- `get_it` (service locator / DI — chosen, see R4)
- `flutter_secure_storage` (on-device token persistence — chosen, see R5)
- `equatable` (value equality for states/entities/failures)
- Dev-only: `mocktail` (fixed by constitution), `bloc_test`

**Storage**: `flutter_secure_storage` only — persists `accessToken`, `refreshToken`, `expiresAt`
between launches (per spec Assumptions). No local database/cache is introduced by F000.

**Testing**: `flutter_test` + `bloc_test` for bloc/presentation logic, `mocktail` for every test
double (data sources, repositories), coverage measured with `fvm flutter test --coverage` and a
`lib/**/domain/**`-scoped lcov filter for the RNF07 gate (≥80%).

**Target Platform**: iOS, portrait orientation only (constitution + requirements §13). No
product-specified minimum iOS deployment target exists in the inputs; the pinned Flutter SDK's
`flutter create` default is kept as-is (see R8) rather than inventing a floor.

**Project Type**: Single Flutter mobile app consuming a frozen, already-documented backend over
HTTPS Edge Functions. No backend/server code is part of this repository.

**Performance Goals**: RNF01 — local actions reflected in the UI in <100 ms; any network call
exceeding 300 ms shows a loading indicator (skeleton/spinner, per prototype's `Skeleton` component).

**Constraints**:
- Clean Architecture, 3 layers (`data/`, `domain/`, `presentation/`) per feature (Principle V).
- Every repository returns `Either<Failure, T>` (Principle II, RNF09).
- Zero visual values hardcoded outside `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (Principle IV, RNF08).
- Domain layer imports neither `package:flutter` nor any `data/` class (Principle V, RNF06).
- No change to the backend, its contract, or its configuration (Principle III, FR-017).
- No direct AI-provider calls from the app (Principle III).
- Real request paths only — `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<x-cerne-function>`, never the OpenAPI REST path
  (Principle III, FR-005).
- `.env` carries exactly `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY`, never committed.
- No RF01–RF10 functional behavior; any such control exists only as an inert placeholder (FR-016).

**Scale/Scope**: 5 screens (Splash, Login/Sign-up toggle, Home/Chat shell, Meus Registros
placeholder, Configurações placeholder) + 1 modal overlay (Sessão expirada) + 1 navigation drawer;
consumes 4 of the backend's 23 operations; 0 persisted business data of its own (tokens only).

## Constitution Check

*GATE: Must pass before Phase 0 research. Re-checked after Phase 1 design — see bottom of this
section.*

| Principle / Standard | Status | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| I. Product Source of Truth | PASS | `docs/input/` read-only; all open decisions resolved in research.md rather than left blocking. |
| II. Fixed Technology Stack | PASS | `flutter_bloc`, `fpdart` `Either`, `mocktail` adopted as-is. `whisper_ggml` is out of scope for F000 (no audio capture exists yet) — not a violation, simply not yet introduced. |
| III. Backend Boundary | PASS | Only `auth-signup`/`auth-login`/`auth-refresh`/`auth-session` called, via `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>`; `apikey` header on every call; `Authorization: Bearer <anon key>` for signup/login/refresh, `Bearer <access token>` for `auth-session`. `.env` already gitignored, untouched by this plan. |
| IV. Design Token Discipline & Visual Fidelity | PASS | `design_tokens.dart` is a Phase 1 output; see data-model.md and R9. |
| V. Clean Architecture Folder Convention | PASS | See Project Structure below; domain layer kept Flutter- and data-free. |
| RNF01 (latency) | PASS | Loading indicator required >300 ms on the 4 auth calls and the splash session check. |
| RNF02/03/04 (PII, retention, RLS) | N/A to F000 | Backend-side; no app logic introduced or required. |
| RNF05 (hard delete) | N/A to F000 | Belongs to the Settings/RF09 unit; Configurações is an inert placeholder here. |
| RNF06 (layer violations) | PASS | Enforced structurally by folder convention; domain entities/usecases/repositories contain no Flutter or data imports. |
| RNF07 (domain coverage ≥80%) | PASS (gate carried into tasks) | Applies to `session` and `auth` domain layers delivered here. |
| RNF08 (visual fidelity) | PASS | All 5 screens sourced from `design_tokens.dart`; see data-model.md. |
| RNF09 (Either + 15/15 error scenarios) | PARTIAL BY DESIGN, not a violation | RNF09's full target is 5 write endpoints × 3 failures, reached incrementally across the whole delivery order (requirements.md §12). F000 contributes the `Either` pattern itself (used by every later repository) plus full timeout/malformed/offline coverage for its own 3 write-ish auth calls (signup, login, refresh — `auth-session` is a read). No Complexity Tracking entry needed: this is the staged rollout the delivery order already anticipates, not a deviation. |

*Post-Phase-1 re-check: see "Post-Design Constitution Check" at the end of this document.*

  value as a `static const`; no screen or widget in the structure above has a reason to define one
  locally — RNF08/Principle IV remain satisfied by construction.
- `Failure` (contracts/failure-taxonomy.md) covers all 13 backend codes, not just the ones F000's

# Research: P-F000 — Foundation

Every item below was a "NEEDS CLARIFICATION" or a constitution-flagged "free" choice (routing, HTTP
client, local cache, DI, secure storage, biometrics, charting). Biometrics and charting are not
exercised by F000, so they are left open for the units that need them (RF03, RF09).

## R1 — Flutter/Dart version to pin via `fvm`

- **Decision**: Pin this project to Flutter `3.47.5` / Dart `3.13.4`, stable channel.
- **Rationale**: The constitution fixes "Flutter and Dart at the version pinned via `fvm`" but no
  `.fvmrc` exists yet in this repo — F000 is where the pin is created. `fvm list` on this machine
  already shows `3.47.5`/stable cached as the global default (released 2026-09-18), avoiding a
  fresh multi-GB download and giving a reproducible, already-verified SDK.
- **Alternatives considered**: Pinning an older LTS-style version — rejected, no such version is
  already available locally and the constitution expresses no preference for anything but
  "the version pinned via fvm," which this satisfies directly.

## R2 — HTTP client

- **Decision**: `dio`.
- **Rationale**: FR-003/FR-004 require one call surface that always yields `Either<Failure, T>`
  and uniformly translates `{code, message, retryable, requestId}` into a typed failure; Principle
  III requires injecting `apikey` and the right `Authorization` value per call. `dio`'s
  `Interceptor` API is the natural place to inject both headers once and to centralize
  timeout/malformed/offline detection for every later unit's write endpoints (RNF09), rather than
  repeating that logic per repository.
- **Alternatives considered**: `package:http` — would need a hand-rolled interceptor-equivalent
  layer for header injection and timeout classification, duplicating what `dio` gives for free;
  rejected as unnecessary extra surface for no benefit given `dio` is already the de-facto standard
  paired with `flutter_bloc` + `fpdart` repositories.

## R3 — Routing and the two "overlay" requirements (side menu, Sessão expirada)

- **Decision**: `go_router` for top-level screen navigation, with a single root `Navigator` stack
  (`context.push`, not `go`/`replace`, from the side menu). The side menu itself is a plain
  `Scaffold.drawer` (`Drawer` widget), not a route. The "Sessão expirada" overlay is a
  non-dismissible `showDialog` raised through a root `navigatorKey` whenever `SessionBloc` observes
  an `AUTH_EXPIRED` failure that silent refresh could not resolve.
- **Rationale**: FR-013/FR-014 and User Story 5 require the screen underneath the overlay to keep
  its exact state (e.g., scroll position). Flutter never disposes a `State` object that is merely
  covered by a drawer or by a dialog route pushed on top of it — only `push`ing (not `go`/replacing)
  guarantees this for screen-to-screen navigation too (FR-011, User Story 4: "returning to
  Home/Chat, confirming Home/Chat's state unchanged"). This reaches both behaviors without a
  nested/branch-navigation scheme.
- **Alternatives considered**: `StatefulShellRoute` (go_router's persistent-tab branches) — gives
  the same state-preservation guarantee but is built for bottom-nav-style parallel branches; Meus
  Registros/Configurações are occasional side-menu destinations, not a tab bar, so plain stack
  `push` is the simpler fit. A hand-built `Overlay`/`OverlayEntry` for the expired-session case was
  considered instead of `showDialog` — rejected: `showDialog` already is an overlay route with a
  scrim, matching the prototype's "centered card over a light scrim" description with less custom
  code.

## R4 — Dependency injection / service location

- **Decision**: `get_it`, with manual registration (no code generation).
- **Rationale**: F000 only wires a handful of singletons (`ApiClient`, `SecureTokenStorage`, two
  repositories, two blocs-as-factories). `get_it` is the standard pairing with `flutter_bloc` for
  exposing repositories/use cases to `BlocProvider`s without threading them through constructors
  manually, and manual registration avoids adding a build-time code-gen dependency for a graph this
  small.
- **Alternatives considered**: `injectable` (codegen over `get_it`) — rejected for now as
  premature; the registration list is small enough that generated code would add build complexity
  without a proportional benefit. Can be introduced later without touching domain code if the
  graph grows.

## R5 — On-device secure storage for tokens

- **Decision**: `flutter_secure_storage`.
- **Rationale**: Assumptions in spec.md require access/refresh tokens to survive app restarts; the
  app ships iOS-only, where `flutter_secure_storage` backs onto the Keychain — appropriate for
  credentials, unlike unencrypted `shared_preferences`.
- **Alternatives considered**: `shared_preferences` — rejected, stores in plaintext and is
  unsuitable for refresh tokens even on a single-platform (iOS) app.

## R6 — Error/Failure mapping scope

- **Decision**: `core/network/failure.dart` models all 13 closed error codes from
  `docs/input/backend/error-taxonomy.md` now, even though F000's own 4 endpoints can only return a
  subset of them.
- **Rationale**: FR-004 says the system must translate "every backend error response['s] error
  code" — worded generically, not scoped to F000's own calls — and this file is exactly the shared
  piece "no single requirement owns but all of them use" that requirements.md §12 assigns to F000.
  Defining it once now means RF01–RF09 never need to touch this file, only add usages of it.
- **Alternatives considered**: Mapping only the codes F000's endpoints can return (`AUTH_EXPIRED`,
  `AUTH_INVALID`, `NETWORK_TIMEOUT`, `NETWORK_OFFLINE`, `VALIDATION_ERROR`, `RATE_LIMITED`) and
  letting later units extend the hierarchy — rejected: the taxonomy is explicitly closed and fully
  known today, so extending it later would be a pure mechanical addition with no new information,
  while leaving it incomplete risks a later unit quietly handling an "unknown" code path instead of
  its real typed `Failure`.

## R7 — Splash-time session check under a network failure

- **Decision**: If `GET auth-session` (or the subsequent `POST auth-refresh` fallback) itself fails
  with `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` or `NETWORK_OFFLINE` — as opposed to resolving to `AUTH_EXPIRED`/
  `AUTH_INVALID` — the splash screen shows its connectivity-aware state with a manual retry action,
  rather than routing straight to the login screen.
- **Rationale**: Spec.md's edge cases and FR-010 require the splash to never leave the user "stuck"
  and User Story 3 only specifies the valid/expired-renewable/none outcomes — a transient network
  failure is a fourth, unspecified case. Routing straight to login would be actively wrong for a
  user who does have a valid stored session but is momentarily offline; silently retrying forever
  would leave them stuck. A visible retry affordance satisfies "never stuck" without discarding a
  potentially-valid session. This is the reasonable technical decision Constitution Principle I
  calls for where the inputs are silent.
- **Alternatives considered**: Auto-retry with exponential backoff and no user action — rejected,
  can still leave the user staring at the splash indefinitely on sustained offline, which the spec's
  edge cases explicitly want to avoid.

## R8 — iOS minimum deployment target

- **Decision**: Leave it at whatever `flutter create` generates for the pinned 3.47.5 SDK; do not
  override it.
- **Rationale**: Neither requirements.md nor the constitution states a minimum iOS version — only
  "iOS, portrait only." Inventing a specific floor (e.g., "iOS 15+") would be an unrequested,
  unverifiable constraint. The SDK's own default is the reasonable technical decision here per
  Constitution Principle I.
- **Alternatives considered**: None — there is no documented requirement to weigh against.

## R9 — `design_tokens.dart` shape and font delivery

- **Decision**: A plain Dart class of `static const` values (colors as `Color`, type scale as
  `TextStyle`, spacing/radii as `double`) feeding a single `ThemeData` built from those constants;
  fonts (`Fraunces`, `Karla`, `IBM Plex Mono`) are bundled as local assets declared in
  `pubspec.yaml`, not fetched at runtime.
- **Rationale**: RNF08 requires zero hardcoded visual values outside this one file — a `static
  const` class makes any other hardcoded value a compile-time-visible outlier (not referencing the
  token file) rather than something only caught by review. Bundling fonts as assets (vs.
  `google_fonts`, which fetches over the network on first use) avoids adding a second runtime
  network dependency beyond the backend itself and keeps text rendering deterministic offline,
  consistent with RNF01's latency intent.
- **Alternatives considered**: `google_fonts` package — rejected: introduces a non-backend network
  fetch and a cache-miss failure mode (slow/no connection on first launch) that bundled assets don't
  have. Obtaining and vendoring the three actual font files is left as an implementation task
  (tasks.md), since this plan does not fetch external binary assets.

## R10 — Home/Chat shell scope under FR-016

- **Decision**: The Home/Chat screen F000 ships shows the fixed header (☰ + "Cerne" wordmark per
  the prototype) and an empty conversation area, plus a composer bar that is rendered but fully
  **disabled** (text field non-editable, send button non-interactive) — no fake messages, no RF04
  wiring.
- **Rationale**: FR-016 allows RF01–RF10 controls to "exist only as an inert placeholder, if at
  all." Showing the chrome disabled (rather than omitting it) keeps the screen visually faithful to
  the prototype's Tela 1 for navigation/overlay testing (User Stories 4 and 5 both exercise
  Home/Chat) without implementing any chat behavior; disabling it (rather than wiring a no-op
  handler) makes the "inert" property visible to a reviewer and to a user, not just true in code.
- **Alternatives considered**: Omitting the composer entirely and showing only an empty state —
  rejected: the chat's own BLoC/scroll-state is what User Story 5's expired-session test needs to
  observe being preserved; a composer absent today would have to be added back by the RF04 unit in
  a way that reshapes this same screen, whereas a disabled composer is forward-compatible (RF04
  only needs to enable it).

- **Decision**: If `GET auth-session` (or the subsequent `POST auth-refresh` fallback) itself fails
  with `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` or `NETWORK_OFFLINE` — as opposed to resolving to `AUTH_EXPIRED`/
  `AUTH_INVALID` — the splash screen shows its connectivity-aware state with a manual retry action,
  rather than routing straight to the login screen.
- **Rationale**: Spec.md's edge cases and FR-010 require the splash to never leave the user "stuck"
  and User Story 3 only specifies the valid/expired-renewable/none outcomes — a transient network
  failure is a fourth, unspecified case. Routing straight to login would be actively wrong for a
  user who does have a valid stored session but is momentarily offline; silently retrying forever
  would leave them stuck. A visible retry affordance satisfies "never stuck" without discarding a
  potentially-valid session. This is the reasonable technical decision Constitution Principle I
  calls for where the inputs are silent.
- **Alternatives considered**: Auto-retry with exponential backoff and no user action — rejected,
  can still leave the user staring at the splash indefinitely on sustained offline, which the spec's
  edge cases explicitly want to avoid.

## R8 — iOS minimum deployment target

- **Decision**: Leave it at whatever `flutter create` generates for the pinned 3.47.5 SDK; do not
  override it.
- **Rationale**: Neither requirements.md nor the constitution states a minimum iOS version — only
  "iOS, portrait only." Inventing a specific floor (e.g., "iOS 15+") would be an unrequested,
  unverifiable constraint. The SDK's own default is the reasonable technical decision here per
  Constitution Principle I.
- **Alternatives considered**: None — there is no documented requirement to weigh against.

## R9 — `design_tokens.dart` shape and font delivery

- **Decision**: A plain Dart class of `static const` values (colors as `Color`, type scale as
  `TextStyle`, spacing/radii as `double`) feeding a single `ThemeData` built from those constants;
  fonts (`Fraunces`, `Karla`, `IBM Plex Mono`) are bundled as local assets declared in
  `pubspec.yaml`, not fetched at runtime.
- **Rationale**: RNF08 requires zero hardcoded visual values outside this one file — a `static
  const` class makes any other hardcoded value a compile-time-visible outlier (not referencing the
  token file) rather than something only caught by review. Bundling fonts as assets (vs.
  `google_fonts`, which fetches over the network on first use) avoids adding a second runtime
  network dependency beyond the backend itself and keeps text rendering deterministic offline,
  consistent with RNF01's latency intent.
- **Alternatives considered**: `google_fonts` package — rejected: introduces a non-backend network
  fetch and a cache-miss failure mode (slow/no connection on first launch) that bundled assets don't
  have. Obtaining and vendoring the three actual font files is left as an implementation task
  (tasks.md), since this plan does not fetch external binary assets.

## R10 — Home/Chat shell scope under FR-016

- **Decision**: The Home/Chat screen F000 ships shows the fixed header (☰ + "Cerne" wordmark per
  the prototype) and an empty conversation area, plus a composer bar that is rendered but fully
  **disabled** (text field non-editable, send button non-interactive) — no fake messages, no RF04
  wiring.
- **Rationale**: FR-016 allows RF01–RF10 controls to "exist only as an inert placeholder, if at
  all." Showing the chrome disabled (rather than omitting it) keeps the screen visually faithful to
  the prototype's Tela 1 for navigation/overlay testing (User Stories 4 and 5 both exercise
  Home/Chat) without implementing any chat behavior; disabling it (rather than wiring a no-op
  handler) makes the "inert" property visible to a reviewer and to a user, not just true in code.
- **Alternatives considered**: Omitting the composer entirely and showing only an empty state —
  rejected: the chat's own BLoC/scroll-state is what User Story 5's expired-session test needs to
  observe being preserved; a composer absent today would have to be added back by the RF04 unit in
  a way that reshapes this same screen, whereas a disabled composer is forward-compatible (RF04
  only needs to enable it).

# Data Model: P-F000 — Foundation

Source: spec.md §Key Entities, requirements.md §§8, 11, 13, prototype-extract.md §3. Entities here
are either in-memory domain objects (Session, Account, Failure) or presentation-only state
(AuthFormMode) — F000 introduces no local database.

## Session

Represents whether the user is currently authenticated; drives splash routing (FR-009) and the
"Sessão expirada" overlay (FR-013).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `accessToken` | `String` | From `auth-login`/`auth-signup`/`auth-refresh`'s `session.accessToken`. Stored, never logged. |
| `refreshToken` | `String` | From the same responses' `session.refreshToken`. Stored, never logged. |
| `expiresAt` | `int` (unix seconds) | From `session.expiresAt` (signup/login) or `auth-session`'s `data.expiresAt`. |
| `tokenType` | `String` | From `session.tokenType` (expected `"bearer"`); carried through unchanged. |
| `account` | `Account` | Denormalized from the same response's `user` object. |

**Derived state — `SessionStatus`** (domain enum/sealed type consumed by `SessionBloc`):

```
checking            # splash in progress — auth-session call (or no stored tokens yet checked)
authenticated(Session)
expiredRenewable    # auth-session returned AUTH_EXPIRED; auth-refresh not yet attempted/resolved
unauthenticated     # no stored tokens, or refresh itself failed (AUTH_INVALID/AUTH_EXPIRED on the refresh token)
```

**State transitions** (FR-009, FR-010, User Story 3, Edge Cases):

```
[app launch]
  no stored tokens            -> unauthenticated -> route: Login/SignUp
  stored tokens present       -> checking (GET auth-session, Bearer = stored accessToken)
      200                     -> authenticated -> route: Home/Chat
      401 AUTH_EXPIRED         -> expiredRenewable -> POST auth-refresh (Bearer = anon key, body.refreshToken)
            200                -> authenticated (new Session stored) -> route: Home/Chat
            401 (AUTH_INVALID | AUTH_EXPIRED) -> unauthenticated -> route: Login/SignUp   (never left on splash — see R7)
      NETWORK_TIMEOUT | NETWORK_OFFLINE -> splash shows retry affordance, no route change yet (R7)

[active screen, any later authenticated call returns AUTH_EXPIRED]
  authenticated -> attempt silent auth-refresh in background
      success -> authenticated, screen state untouched, no overlay shown
      failure -> expiredRenewable -> show "Sessão expirada" overlay over the current screen (state preserved underneath)

["Sessão expirada" overlay visible]
  user taps "Entrar novamente", re-authenticates (auth-login) -> authenticated, overlay dismissed, underlying screen state restored
  a second AUTH_EXPIRED arrives while the overlay is still up -> overlay persists/reappears (Edge Cases) — never silently proceeds with the stale session
```

## Account

The identity a person signs up with or logs into (spec.md Key Entities; requirements.md §8 `users`
table, scoped to what the auth endpoints return).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | `String` (uuid) | From `user.id` in signup/login responses, or `auth-session`'s `data.user.id`. |
| `email` | `String` | From `user.email`. Also the sign-up/login form input (FR-006, FR-007). |

Password is never modeled as a field on `Account` — it exists only transiently as sign-up/login
form input and an outbound request-body value; it is never stored or logged.

## Backend Failure

The error outcome every call this unit introduces (`auth-signup`, `auth-login`, `auth-refresh`,
`auth-session`) can produce, carrying enough information to pick a message and a retry affordance
(FR-004, FR-015). Modeled as a sealed `Failure` hierarchy in `core/network/failure.dart`, covering
**all 13** backend codes per research.md R6 (not just the ones reachable from F000's own calls):

| `Failure` subtype | Source `code` | HTTP | `retryable` |
|---|---|---|---|
| `AuthExpiredFailure` | `AUTH_EXPIRED` | 401 | no |
| `AuthInvalidFailure` | `AUTH_INVALID` | 401 | no |
| `NetworkTimeoutFailure` | `NETWORK_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NetworkOfflineFailure` | `NETWORK_OFFLINE` | *(no response)* | yes |
| `ValidationFailure` | `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | no |
| `PiiCheckFailedFailure` | `PII_CHECK_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `EmbeddingFailedFailure` | `EMBEDDING_FAILED` | 502 | yes |
| `AiGenerationTimeoutFailure` | `AI_GENERATION_TIMEOUT` | 504 | yes |
| `NotFoundFailure` | `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | no |
| `RateLimitedFailure` | `RATE_LIMITED` | 429 | yes |
| `ExportEmptyPeriodFailure` | `EXPORT_EMPTY_PERIOD` | 400 | no |
| `PayloadTooLargeFailure` | `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 | no |
| `OcrNoTextFailure` | `OCR_NO_TEXT` | 400 | no |

Every subtype carries the raw `message` (String) and `requestId` (String) through unchanged; `code`
and `retryable` are implied by the subtype itself (each is a fixed pair per the closed taxonomy).
F000's own screens only ever construct/handle `AuthExpiredFailure`, `AuthInvalidFailure`,
`NetworkTimeoutFailure`, `NetworkOfflineFailure`, `ValidationFailure`, and `RateLimitedFailure`; the
remaining seven exist so later units never redefine this file.

**Validation rule**: a `NETWORK_OFFLINE` failure is synthesized client-side by `ApiClient` (dio)
when a request ends with no response at all (connection error) — it is the one code the backend
itself never emits as an HTTP response (error-taxonomy.md).

## Placeholder Destination

A navigable screen that exists so a later unit has somewhere to add functionality, with no
behavior of its own in F000 (FR-012).

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `route` | `String` | `/records` or `/settings`. |
| `label` | `String` | "Meus Registros" / "Configurações" — exact prototype strings. |

No other state. Rendered as a static "ainda não disponível"-style message per the prototype's
general empty-state pattern; no entity/list data is fetched.

## Presentation-only state (not persisted, not a domain entity)

- **`AuthFormMode`** (`login | signUp`) — which mode the single login/sign-up screen is toggled to
  (FR-008). Lives in `AuthBloc`'s state, reset to `login` each time the screen is (re-)entered.
- **Form field errors** (empty-field validation, Edge Cases) — transient widget/bloc state, shown
  inline, never reaches the network layer (no call is made for an empty field).

## Design Tokens (`lib/core/design_tokens.dart`)

Transcribed verbatim from prototype-extract.md §3 — this file does not interpret or round any
value, it copies the panel.

**Colors** (14 named constants): `colorPrimary #1F3D34`, `colorPrimaryPressed #16281F`,
`colorOnPrimary #F5F1E8`, `colorAccent #C98A3E`, `colorOnAccent #241C0D`, `colorSecondary #7C8B6F`,
`colorSurfaceBg #F2EFE7`, `colorSurfaceElevated #FBF9F4`, `colorBorder #E1DACB`,
`colorTextPrimary #241F19`, `colorTextSecondary #6B6255`, `colorError #B3402A`,
`colorSuccess #4C6B4F`, `colorWarningSync #C98A3E`, `colorInfoOffline #5C7A93`. F000 additionally
needs the two screen-specific colors called out as not in the panel but required for faithful
rendering of elements it ships: user chat bubble `#D9DFD3` (`colorChatBubbleUser`) — used by the
Home/Chat shell's composer preview area — and category-chip text `#3F4A38` is **not** needed by
F000 (no chips exist before RF06/RF07) and is therefore left for the unit that introduces chips.

**Typography** (8 named `TextStyle` constants, per the table in prototype-extract.md §3):
`textDisplayLg`, `textHeadlineMd`, `textTitleLg`, `textTitleSm`, `textBodyLg`, `textBodyMd`,
`textLabelMd`, `textMonoCaption` — font family/weight/size/line-height exactly as specified
(Fraunces, Karla, IBM Plex Mono; see research.md R9 for asset delivery).

**Spacing**: `spacingXs 4`, `spacingSm 8`, `spacingMd 16`, `spacingLg 24`, `spacingXl 32`,
`spacing2xl 48` (all `double`, dp).

**Radii**: `radiusSm 8`, `radiusMd 16`, `radiusLg 24`, `radiusFull 999` (all `double`, dp).

**Elevation**: `elevation1` and `elevation2` as `BoxShadow`/`List<BoxShadow>` constants matching
the two shadow specs in prototype-extract.md §3.

F000 does not need the `Spine`, `Icons` (beyond `list`/`plus`/`gear`/`notebook`/`chat-circle-text`
for its own 5 screens), or component-level tokens (bookmark, sync badge, export card, etc.) that
belong to later units' screens — those are added to this same file when those units need them,
never duplicated elsewhere.

# Contract: `ApiClient` (`lib/core/network/api_client.dart`)

The single way any feature calls the backend (FR-003). Every later unit's `data/` layer depends on
this, never on `dio` directly.

## Construction

```dart
class ApiClient {
  ApiClient({required Dio dio, required SecureTokenStorage tokenStorage, required String anonKey});

  Future<Either<Failure, Map<String, dynamic>>> call(
    String function, {               // e.g. "auth-login" — never a REST path (FR-005)
    required String method,          // "GET" | "POST" | "PATCH" | "DELETE"
    Map<String, dynamic>? body,
    List<String>? pathSegments,      // appended in the order the OpenAPI path declares them
    AuthMode authMode = AuthMode.userSession, // or AuthMode.anonKey
  });
}

enum AuthMode { anonKey, userSession }
```

## Behavior

1. **URL construction**: `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/<function>/<pathSegments...>` — read from `.env`'s
   `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL`. Never the OpenAPI document's REST-notation path (Principle III, FR-005).
2. **Headers, every call**: `apikey: <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>` (from `.env`).
3. **`Authorization` header**:
   - `AuthMode.anonKey` → `Bearer <SUPABASE_ANON_KEY>` — used for `auth-signup`, `auth-login`,
     `auth-refresh` (no user session exists yet or is being replaced).
   - `AuthMode.userSession` → `Bearer <stored accessToken>` (read from `SecureTokenStorage`) — used
     for `auth-session` and every `bearerAuth` operation added by later units.
4. **Success**: returns `Right(data)` where `data` is the parsed `data` object from the response
   envelope (`{data, meta}`), discarding `meta` unless a future unit's contract says otherwise.
5. **Failure**: any non-2xx response with the `{code, message, retryable, requestId}` error body is
   passed to `ErrorMapper.fromResponse(...)` → `Left(Failure)` (see `failure-taxonomy.md`). A dio
   `DioExceptionType.connectionError`/no-response condition is mapped directly to
   `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure(...))` without a parse attempt (error-taxonomy.md: `NETWORK_OFFLINE`
   never arrives as an HTTP response). A dio timeout is mapped to `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure(...))`.
6. **Never throws** past this boundary — every exception dio can raise is caught and mapped to a
   `Failure` before returning, satisfying FR-003 ("never an unhandled crash").

## Who depends on this

`AuthRemoteDataSource`, `SessionRemoteDataSource` (this unit) and every later unit's `*RemoteDataSource`.

# Contract: `AuthRepository` (`lib/features/auth/domain/repositories/auth_repository.dart`)

Domain-layer interface; `AuthBloc` (presentation) depends on this and on nothing in `auth/data/`
directly (RNF06).

```dart
abstract class AuthRepository {
  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> signUp({required String email, required String password});
  Future<Either<Failure, Session>> login({required String email, required String password});
}
```

- **`signUp`** → calls `auth-signup` (`AuthMode.anonKey`). Maps to FR-006. On `Right`, the use case
  persists the returned `Session` via `SecureTokenStorage` before the bloc emits its authenticated
  state — sign-up and login leave the app in an identical post-condition (spec.md User Story 2).
- **`login`** → calls `auth-login` (`AuthMode.anonKey`). Maps to FR-007. Same persistence step.
- Both return `Left(ValidationFailure)` for a malformed submission, `Left(AuthInvalidFailure)` for
  wrong credentials / already-registered email, `Left(NetworkTimeoutFailure)` /
  `Left(NetworkOfflineFailure)` for connectivity problems — never a thrown exception (FR-003).
- Empty-field submissions never reach this interface at all — the presentation layer validates and
  blocks the call before invoking it (Edge Cases: "no network call made").

## Use cases wrapping this repository

- `SignUpUseCase(AuthRepository)` / `LoginUseCase(AuthRepository)` — thin pass-throughs today, kept
  as separate classes (not inlined into the bloc) so later units' tests and the domain-coverage
  gate (RNF07) have a single, directly-testable unit per operation, independent of bloc wiring.

## Who depends on this

`AuthBloc` only, in this unit. The interface is intentionally narrow (no `logout`, no
`refresh` — those belong to `SessionRepository` below, since they are session-lifecycle concerns
rather than "an account submits credentials") — this keeps the boundary RF10's note about "a shared
interface / use case, never a directly imported repository" generalizes to: every feature talks to
auth/session through these two interfaces, never through each other's `data/` classes.

# Quickstart: validating P-F000 — Foundation

Prerequisites, run commands, and expected outcomes for proving this unit's 5 user stories end to
end. Interface details (headers, URLs, failure types) are in `contracts/`; entity/state details
are in `data-model.md`.

## Prerequisites

- `fvm use 3.47.5` run once at the repo root (installs/links the pinned SDK — see research.md R1).
- `.env` present at the repo root with `FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL` and `SUPABASE_ANON_KEY` (already exists
  in this repo; never commit it).
- `fvm flutter pub get`.
- A real or simulated iOS device/runner (`fvm flutter devices`), since the target platform is iOS.

## Setup

```bash
fvm flutter pub get
fvm flutter run -d <ios-device-or-simulator-id>
```

## Automated checks

```bash
fvm flutter analyze                                   # 0 issues, incl. no flutter imports under domain/ (RNF06)
fvm flutter test --coverage                            # unit + bloc tests (mocktail, bloc_test)
lcov --extract coverage/lcov.info 'lib/*/domain/*' -o coverage/domain.info
genhtml coverage/domain.info -o coverage/domain_html    # inspect: >= 80% (RNF07)
```

## Manual / integration validation scenarios

Each maps directly to a spec.md Acceptance Scenario.

1. **Login (User Story 1)**
   - Launch with no stored session → login screen.
   - Enter a valid, existing email/password → lands on Home/Chat.
   - Enter a wrong password → inline, non-crashing error, stays on login screen, can retry.
   - Turn off network, submit → retryable connection-error message, no hang/crash.

2. **Sign-up (User Story 2)**
   - From the login screen, tap the toggle link → title/CTA switch to "Criar conta" (same screen,
     no navigation).
   - Submit a brand-new email/password → account created, lands directly on Home/Chat.
   - Submit an already-registered email → clear error, form stays editable, no crash.

3. **Launch routing (User Story 3)** — exercise all three stored-session conditions:
   - Valid session on device → splash, then straight to Home/Chat, no credentials re-entered.
   - No stored session (fresh install, or after a manual token wipe) → splash, then login screen.
   - Expired-but-refreshable session (manually expire the stored `accessToken`, keep a valid
     `refreshToken`) → splash, silent `auth-refresh`, lands on Home/Chat without any prompt.

4. **Base navigation (User Story 4)**
   - From Home/Chat, open the drawer (☰) → see Meus Registros, Configurações.
   - Visit Meus Registros, return to Home/Chat → chat shell state (e.g., scroll position) unchanged.
   - Same for Configurações.
   - Opening the drawer itself visibly scrims the current screen without resetting it.

5. **Session-expired overlay (User Story 5)**
   - Get to a known state on a screen (e.g., scroll Home/Chat partway).
   - Force a session-expired response (e.g., revoke/expire the access token server-side, or stub it
     in a debug build) while that screen is active.
   - Confirm the "Sessão expirada" card appears over a light scrim, screen content still visible
     and unchanged underneath.
   - Tap "Entrar novamente", re-authenticate → overlay dismissed, screen state (scroll position)
     restored exactly.
   - Repeat the forced expiry while the overlay is still visible (before dismissing) → overlay
     persists/reappears rather than letting the user proceed.

## Expected outcome

All 5 scenarios above pass; `flutter analyze` and `flutter test --coverage` are clean; the
`lib/**/domain/**` coverage report meets RNF07; no screen's rendered output uses a color, font, or
spacing value traceable to anything other than `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (spot-check via code
review, since this is not yet an automated lint in this unit).

   - Submit a brand-new email/password → account created, lands directly on Home/Chat.
   - Submit an already-registered email → clear error, form stays editable, no crash.

3. **Launch routing (User Story 3)** — exercise all three stored-session conditions:
   - Valid session on device → splash, then straight to Home/Chat, no credentials re-entered.
   - No stored session (fresh install, or after a manual token wipe) → splash, then login screen.
   - Expired-but-refreshable session (manually expire the stored `accessToken`, keep a valid
     `refreshToken`) → splash, silent `auth-refresh`, lands on Home/Chat without any prompt.

4. **Base navigation (User Story 4)**
   - From Home/Chat, open the drawer (☰) → see Meus Registros, Configurações.
   - Visit Meus Registros, return to Home/Chat → chat shell state (e.g., scroll position) unchanged.
   - Same for Configurações.
   - Opening the drawer itself visibly scrims the current screen without resetting it.

5. **Session-expired overlay (User Story 5)**
   - Get to a known state on a screen (e.g., scroll Home/Chat partway).
   - Force a session-expired response (e.g., revoke/expire the access token server-side, or stub it
     in a debug build) while that screen is active.
   - Confirm the "Sessão expirada" card appears over a light scrim, screen content still visible
     and unchanged underneath.
   - Tap "Entrar novamente", re-authenticate → overlay dismissed, screen state (scroll position)
     restored exactly.
   - Repeat the forced expiry while the overlay is still visible (before dismissing) → overlay
     persists/reappears rather than letting the user proceed.

## Expected outcome

All 5 scenarios above pass; `flutter analyze` and `flutter test --coverage` are clean; the
`lib/**/domain/**` coverage report meets RNF07; no screen's rendered output uses a color, font, or
spacing value traceable to anything other than `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` (spot-check via code
review, since this is not yet an automated lint in this unit).
